doubts: Kind one_way: the page describes the walk east to west, from the Rolling River car park to the Wangapeka Road car park, and gives the time and distance for the whole way; the west end is also the start for people coming from the West Coast road, but that is the same track walked the other way, so it is not a separate way. The main way start is matched to road end F1 and end to road end F2 on the text's own car park wording; the packet has no separate feature for the Rolling Junction road end, which is not used. W2 is the Biggs Tops/Trevor Carter Hut alternative with its own heading and time, ending at Taipo footbridge. The page also offers three ways back to the main route from Trevor Carter Hut: Lost Valley Track to Helicopter Flat Hut, Saxon Falls Track rejoining near Tabernacle lookout, and across the Karamea to Taipo footbridge; the last is W2's end and the first two are recorded as exits. The Lost Valley Track ref T3 is a best match to the map track of that name and is not certain. Cecil Kings Hut and Stag Flat Shelter are described as near the way (5 min up the maintrack; adjacent to the route) and are placed in not_on_route, not huts, which is a judgement. Fords are recorded for Chime Creek and the Karamea River on the main way because the text says 'fording' and 'fording can be avoided'; the Karamea crossing on the alternative is not described as a ford and has no how. McHarrie Creek is described as unbridged and not crossable in high rainfall, but the text does not say to cross it, so it has no how. The Little Wanganui swing bridge and the Lawrence Stream swing bridge are bridges, not fords. The landslip dam debris and the Dart River ford are not walked places and are not recorded.
